topic: 兴奋毒性：谷氨酸的双刃剑与突触内外的生死抉择

sources.citation: Hardingham GE, Bading H (2010). Synaptic versus extrasynaptic NMDA receptor signalling: implications for neurodegenerative disorders. Nature Reviews Neuroscience 11(9):682-96.
sources.key_contribution: 突触vs突触外NMDAR二分范式；χ形模型；CREB/Jacob/DAPK1/Calpain-STEP-p38机制；美金刚的选择性原理
sources.evidence_strength: 综述（整合多个原始研究室20年发现）
sources.limitations: 主要来自体外和啮齿动物模型；人脑直接验证有限

sources.citation: Choi DW (1987). Ionic dependence of glutamate neurotoxicity. The Journal of Neuroscience 7(2):369-79.
sources.key_contribution: 两相模型（Na⁺/Cl⁻依赖早期相 + Ca²⁺依赖迟发相）；钙假说的奠基实验
sources.evidence_strength: 原始实验（体外皮层神经元培养，离子操控）
sources.limitations: 体外系统；神经元培养 vs 体内环境有差异

sources.citation: Verma M, Lizama BN, Chu CT (2022). Excitotoxicity, calcium and mitochondria: a triad in synaptic neurodegeneration. Translational Neurodegeneration 11(1):3.
sources.key_contribution: 钙-线粒体三联体；MCU/NCLX轴；EMT（兴奋性线粒体毒性）概念；PD/AD/ALS/HD中线粒体Ca²⁺失调的疾病特异性机制
sources.evidence_strength: 综述（覆盖多种神经退行性疾病的细胞/动物模型研究）
sources.limitations: 慢性病EMT的直接人类证据仍然有限

sources.citation: Arnold FJ, Putka AF, Raychaudhuri U, Hsu S, Bedlack RS, Bennett CL, La Spada AR (2024). Revisiting Glutamate Excitotoxicity in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis and Age-Related Neurodegeneration. International Journal of Molecular Sciences 25(10):5516.
sources.key_contribution: ALS中EAAT2丢失的定量数据（60-70%患者）；GluR2亚基ADAR2编辑缺陷；Ca²⁺可渗透AMPA受体机制；一级和二级兴奋毒性通路分类
sources.evidence_strength: 综述（包含临床病理数据和动物模型）
sources.limitations: 聚焦ALS和老年相关疾病，覆盖面有所限制

sources.citation: Neves D, Salazar IL, Almeida RD, Silva RM (2023). Molecular mechanisms of ischemia and glutamate excitotoxicity. Life Sciences 328:121814.
sources.key_contribution: 缺血兴奋毒性的分子机制综述；GLT-1反向运输；NAD代谢的作用；Zhou等人2015对突触内/外二分模型的挑战
sources.limitations: 未读全文；缺血特异性聚焦

sources.citation: Soriano FX, Martel MA, Papadia S, Vaslin A, Clarke P, Bortolozzi M, Buondaleone-Meini F, Henderson N, Brown AS, Wyllie DJ, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Hardingham GE (2008). Specific targeting of pro-death NMDA receptor signals with differing reliance on the NR2B PDZ ligand. The Journal of Neuroscience 28(42):10696-710.
sources.key_contribution: PSD-95/nNOS解耦合策略；PDZ相互作用的选择性；nerinetide（Tat-NR2B9c）的实验基础
sources.evidence_strength: 原始实验（神经元培养 + 突触可塑性保留验证）
sources.limitations: 体外为主；nerinetide临床转化结果喜忧参半

sources.citation: Soriano FX, Hardingham GE (2007). Compartmentalized NMDA receptor signalling to survival and death. The Journal of Physiology 584(Pt 2):381-7.
sources.key_contribution: 空间隔离NMDAR信号的概念框架；等量Ca²⁺但不同位置引发不同命运的原始阐述；PDZ蛋白在决定信号方向中的作用
sources.limitations: 简短综述；主要依赖Hardingham研究室自身数据
